body: From the DM-185 review (orchestrator, this run) — fix here, since corrective work builds on it: `completed` bypasses the sized/specific gate (src/core/services/experiments.ts:245 requireSchedulable returns early for every status but scheduled/in_progress); an experiment with unsized vague work can go proposed -> completed. Gate `completed` too. Vagueness is a length test only (plan/experiments.ts:511: 'x'.repeat(40) passes); strengthen it as corrective sprints will rely on it.
